Experimental tools

Bring your AI setup into a Brainstem you own

Your instructions, skills, tools and memory from another AI assistant or AI coding tool, as plain files on your device.

Install into Brainstem

curl -fsSL https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/docs/experimental/ai-migration/ai_migration_agent.py -o ~/.brainstem/src/rapp_brainstem/agents/ai_migration_agent.py

One file, standard Python only. To remove it, delete the file. View the agent file.

How it works

  1. Install Brainstem. Follow the Brainstem installer. It runs on your existing GitHub Copilot plan.
  2. Drop in the agent. Run the install command above. It saves one file into your Brainstem's agents/ folder. No restart needed.
  3. Say "scan", then "plan", then "apply". Scan lists what it finds, by folder and item type. Plan says what each item becomes. Apply writes a new review folder under ~/.brainstem/imports/. Apply is a dry run until you say to write.
  4. Review and merge. Read soul.import.md and copy what you want into your soul.md. Install the generated agents when you are ready. "Undo" removes exactly what an apply added.

If your AI has custom assistants with no file export, copy their instructions into soul.import.md.

What it brings over

In your current setupIn your Brainstem
Instructions filesA soul addition, soul.import.md, that you merge
Skills, subagents and commandsGenerated single-file agents
Tool servers (MCP)Listed as "needs a bridge", with every key removed
HooksNot carried. A Brainstem has no event hooks; rebuild one as an agent you call
Memory filesMemory entries, memory.import.md
Exported conversationsAn optional read-only archive

What stays on your device

The agent reads local files only. It skips known key and sign-in files, such as .env or auth.json, and any file that holds a private key, and it tells you each file it skipped and why. A skill or project with a word like "auth" or "session" in its name still comes over. It removes key-looking values from everything it writes. It never overwrites soul.md or an agent you already have.

When you use it through a Brainstem, its replies (names and counts, never file contents or keys) go to the model you chose, as any chat does.

How the setups compare

Hosted AI assistantCloud AI coding toolYour Brainstem
ArchitectureA web or mobile app that the provider runsA local app or terminal tool that calls the provider's modelsA small local server on your device that calls models through GitHub Copilot
Plugins and extensionsThe provider's add-ons and connectorsConfig-file plugins, skills, commands and tool serversSingle-file Python agents in your agents/ folder
Where your data livesMostly in your account with the providerSettings and history in a folder on your device; prompts go to the providerSoul, agents and memory as plain files on your device; prompts go to the model you choose
Cost modelSubscription tiersSubscription tiers or per-token API billingYour existing GitHub Copilot plan

As of 2026-10-29. Pricing models change; check each provider's own pricing page.

GitHub Copilot offers models from several providers, so bringing your setup over keeps your choice of model. What you own is your setup.
